title: ResetBiology
bodyText:
Back
V1
PITCHFORKS III
Frankenstein lightning ear trainer

All four practice chambers are available below. Listen & Tap can enter immediately with deliberate answer buttons; Voice Lightning begins the required comfortable-range check. No notes are granted by practice.

Practice lane: VOICE LIGHTNING · real microphone · comfortable range required. Choose the lane above before entering a chamber.

PITCHFORKS PRACTICE ARCADE

Enter any existing chamber

Four untimed music challenges. Choose one and sing through the encounter.

PRACTICE CHAMBER

Dungeon · Torchmaster

One-note flame lock

Listen, sing the exact note, and hold until the torch answers.

HEAR → SING → CHARGE → STRIKE

PLAY THIS ENCOUNTER

PRACTICE CHAMBER

Village Gate · Choirmaster

Short chorus phrase

Sing the existing admitted-note phrase at your own pace.

HEAR THE CHORUS → SING EACH ANSWER

PLAY THIS ENCOUNTER

PRACTICE CHAMBER

Bell Tower · Bellringer

Two-note bell interval

Listen to each bell and sing back the exact note.

BELL CUE → VOICE LOCK → BELL RELEASE

PLAY THIS ENCOUNTER

PRACTICE CHAMBER

Cathedral · Final Storm

Out-and-back recital

Sing the existing cathedral sequence out, then back.

STORM PHRASE → VOICE LOCK → RETURN PHRASE

PLAY THIS ENCOUNTER

HOW YOU DEFEND
